story_type: three overdue boaters on top of a capsized hull, boat crew pickup
hook: Three boaters never came home. They were on top of this hull.
narration: Three boaters never came home, and this is where the Coast Guard found them: on top of their own capsized boat.
They were near Captiva Island, on the Gulf coast of Florida, when it rolled over.
From the air, the hull was a small white shape with three people huddled on top.
Overdue means someone ashore reported that they never came back. That call is often what starts the whole search.
A Coast Guard boat crew came alongside, and one by one the three were pulled aboard.
outcome: The crew brought all three boaters back to emergency medical services waiting at the Coast Guard station.
title: Overdue boaters found on a flipped hull
description:
On Sunday, Feb. 23, 2025, Coast Guard crews located and rescued three overdue boaters near Captiva Island, Florida, after their vessel capsized.
